forward_eligibility_constraint: Measured and reproducible, but deliberately not consumed by Forward. It covers only the minimal slot-lifetime control skeleton, not the FIA source's full per-iteration scalar program, and at roughly 7.19 ns per iteration it contributes well under one percent of any 910B FA task in the canonical set -- about 0.5 us across the ~66 descriptors per AIC of FLASHATTN_B1_S8192_HQ32_HKV8_D128_C0, whose measured duration is 51096 ns. Its value here is as a falsification: AIC scalar control does not scale with active AIC group count and cannot account for the under-predicted body of the 910B FA residual.

measurement.host_span_not_published: aclrtEventElapsedTime host spans failed the declared 5% process-median stability gate at three processes, so no mix-task envelope parameter is published from this campaign; the host medians are recorded in the report for reference only
measurement.timing_boundary: internal: GetSystemCycle before the first iteration's WaitFlag<MTE1_MTE2> to GetSystemCycle after PipeBarrier<PIPE_ALL> following the last slot release, max over AIC cores per launch; host: aclrtEventElapsedTime across launch and synchronize; envelope = host minus internal; process median per cell

publication_scope.control_body: one source L1 slot lifetime with the descriptor removed: WaitFlag<MTE1_MTE2> on a two-slot ping-pong, one descriptor's source and destination address arithmetic, SetFlag<MTE2_MTE1>, WaitFlag<MTE2_MTE1>, SetFlag<MTE1_MTE2>; no DataCopy, LoadData, Mmad, Fixpipe, Vector arithmetic or production memory traffic
